description: This file defines a NestJS guard class 'PlatformPlanGuard' that enforces access control based on organization platform plans, including methods for checking plan levels and caching results in Redis.

classes.name: PlatformPlanGuard
classes.description: A guard class that checks if a user's organization has the required platform plan for access.

methods.name: canActivate
methods.description: Main method to determine if access is granted based on organization plan.

methods.name: checkPlatformPlanAccess
methods.description: Checks if the organization meets the minimum plan requirements, with caching.
